question: Which of the following countries will host the ICC T20 Men’s Cricket World Cup 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Indies and USA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The ICC T20 Men's Cricket World Cup 2024 will be hosted by **West Indies and USA**.
 
• This will be the first time that the USA is co-hosting an ICC World Cup event.
 
• The tournament is expected to feature 20 teams, the largest in the history of the ICC T20 World Cup.
 
• The event aims to expand cricket's reach in North America and bring in new audiences.
 
• Both countries have been preparing their infrastructure to meet the international standards required for hosting such a major tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC T20 World Cup**

 
 
• The ICC T20 World Cup is a biennial international championship of Twenty20 International cricket organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• The first tournament was held in 2007 in South Africa, and the Indian team emerged as the winner.
 
• The tournament format includes a combination of group stages and knockout rounds.
 
 
 
• **Cricket in the USA**
 
 
• Cricket has been growing in popularity in the USA over recent years, with several domestic leagues and international matches being held.
 
• The USA Cricket Association is the governing body responsible for the development and promotion of the sport in the country.
 
• The country has been investing in cricket infrastructure, including building new stadiums and training facilities.
 
 
 
• **West Indies Cricket**
 
 
• The West Indies cricket team represents a collection of Caribbean countries and is governed by Cricket West Indies.
 
• The team has a rich history in international cricket, having won multiple ICC Cricket World Cups and ICC T20 World Cups.
 
• West Indies is known for producing some of the most iconic cricketers in the sport's history.
